v0.2.7 fixes Codex subagent attribution so routed requests count under the provider and model that actually served them, and stops long project names from stretching CLI tables and the usage page.

- **Codex subagent attribution:** a Codex subagent records its own session id, while the router proxy log carries the parent conversation id, so subagent requests previously found no matching row and kept the default OpenAI attribution. The collector now reads the `parent_thread_id` family marker from the rollout `session_meta` (falling back to the object-form `source.subagent.thread_spawn.parent_thread_id` for older Codex builds) and stores it on messages and sessions. Attribution expands the whole family tree, including intermediate subagents that produced no storable messages, and matches at the family root, so subagent tokens appear under the provider and model that actually served them.
- **Model validation:** a proxy row is attributed to a message only when the requested model matches after normalization (`ccs-<provider>/` prefix, `[...]`-style window suffix, case, and surrounding whitespace). Logs without `request_model` fall back to comparing the upstream model. When both sides carry different aggregated provider prefixes, they are never paired, so nearby requests for different models in the same family are no longer cross-attributed.
- **Long project names:** Project columns in `query` results and session tables are capped at 30 display columns with an ellipsis, and the usage page truncates long project names like session titles, showing the full value on hover or through an info button that appears only when the text overflows. Display only; query output, exports, and stored data keep the full value.

Upgrade with `token-usage update`. The database migrates to schema v8 automatically (an `agent_parent_id` column and index on `messages` and `sessions`); no configuration or manual database change is required. The parser version is bumped, so the startup catch-up pass on the next daemon start re-reads all previously scanned Claude and Codex session files: this backfills family links for existing Codex subagent sessions, and attribution is recomputed for the affected families, correcting historical rows. A daemon that `token-usage update` restarted starts this pass immediately; one that was stopped runs it on its next `token-usage daemon start`. Only this one catch-up pass takes longer and uses more CPU and disk; later incremental collections are unaffected. Existing commands, configuration keys, and API routes remain compatible.

v0.2.7 修复 Codex 子代理归因，经路由的请求按实际承接的供应商与模型统计；长项目名不再撑宽 CLI 表格与用量统计页。

- **Codex 子代理归因：** 子代理会话记录自己的会话 id，而路由中间件日志记录父会话 id，此前的精确匹配找不到对应行，子代理请求的归因一直停留在默认的 OpenAI 来源。采集端现在读取 rollout `session_meta` 的 `parent_thread_id` 家族标记（旧版 Codex 回退解析对象形态 `source.subagent.thread_spawn.parent_thread_id`），写入消息与会话。归因按家族树展开并按家族根匹配，包含没有任何可入库消息的中间层子代理，子代理请求的 token 因此出现在实际承接的供应商与模型下。
- **模型校验：** 只有请求模型归一后一致（`ccs-<provider>/` 前缀、`[...]` 形式的窗口后缀、大小写与首尾空白）才配对；无 `request_model` 的旧日志回退比较上游模型；两侧聚合供应商前缀不同则不配对。同一家族内时间相邻但模型不同的请求不再被错配。
- **长项目名：** `query` 结果与会话明细的 Project 列限制为 30 个显示列宽、超出截断加省略号；用量统计页按会话标题同款规则截断长项目名，悬停或点击仅在溢出时出现的信息按钮查看完整值。仅影响显示，查询输出、导出与库内数据均保留完整值。

使用 `token-usage update` 升级。数据库自动迁移到 schema v8（`messages` 与 `sessions` 新增 `agent_parent_id` 列及索引），无需改动配置或手动迁移。解析版本号已递增，daemon 下次启动的补采（catch-up）阶段会重读所有此前扫描过的 Claude 与 Codex 会话文件：为已有 Codex 子代理会话补齐家族关系，并重算受影响家族的归因，修正历史行。`token-usage update` 会自动重启原先在运行的 daemon，该轮补采随即开始；原本已停止的 daemon 在下次 `token-usage daemon start` 时执行。仅这一轮补采耗时更长、CPU 与磁盘活动更高，后续增量采集不受影响。现有命令、配置键与 API 路由保持兼容。
